messages.subject: How to get list of files uploaded in shiny
parts:
i use this on user side to upload files in shiny
fileInput("files", "Choose CSV processed files", multiple = "TRUE",
                                accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv','.cel'))

On server side: lst <- list.files(input$files[['datapath']]) to get list of files but it returns character(0). How to return the list of files uploaded in shiny.

I tried this also: lst <- list.files(path = "input$files[['datapath']]", pattern =".cel") but does not work.
